registered_addition_groups.rationale: All occurrences are bounded local construction/validation/derivation inside an isolated pure standard-library kernel: set comparisons for exact eight-drive schemas, local dictionary fields used to assemble immutable return receipts, and SHA-256 encoding of canonical candidate/receipt material. The module has no file/database/network/thread/clock/event-append surface, is not imported by the production engine or legacy GoalManagement, mutates no drive/affect/hormone/memory/vector/model/AGP state, and grants no action, speech, persistence, legacy-domain, or M3-E authority.

All occurrences are test-local: deterministic SHA labels, temporary dictionary removal for a fail-closed malformed-input probe, an intentional frozen-dataclass assignment assertion, and local AST import/call collection sets. They add no production mutation or capability and cannot affect runtime state, persistence, authority, actions, speech, or M3-E.
